reply.text:
Electrolytes can help in specific situations: long or very sweaty sessions, hard efforts in the heat, or runs well past an hour. For most lifting sessions and normal training days, water and regular meals cover it. I can't give you a sodium amount, since that depends on how much you sweat, your diet and your health, including anything like blood pressure. A doctor or registered dietitian is the right person for a number.

What I can help with is the training side. Tell me what kind of sessions have you wondering, and how long they run.
